Stewart caught in Swansea rules limbo - gossip
1 of 2
- Published
Ross Stewart's lack of game time with Swansea City is explained as Rangers reportedly want Lyall Cameron in their first-team squad after his season with Dundee United.
Scotland striker Ross Stewart has been left in limbo at Swansea City as manager Vitor Matos was not aware of the English Football League's rules on homegrown players, which excludes Scots and therefore has limited the 30-year-old's appearances. (The Scotsman, external)
Scotland striker Tommy Conway is relishing his new role on the left-wing under Middlesbrough manager Kim Hellberg with their side top of the Championship and the 24-year-old recovering from missing last season's play-off final and the World Cup with an ankle injury. (Scottish Sun, external)
Rangers are planning for Lyall Cameron to be a part of Derek McInnes' squad after the conclusion of the 24-year-old midfielder's season-long loan spell at Dundee United. (Football Insider, external)
Belgium midfielder Nicolas Raskin will not push to leave Rangers during the upcoming January window despite attracting suitors around Europe as the 25-year-old has too much respect for the club. (Football Insider, external)
Aberdeen defender Mats Knoester will be ruled out by a thigh injury for between four to six weeks, but a scan has cleared midfielder Connor Ronan to play in Saturday's Premier Sports Cup semi-final against Rangers. (Press & Journal, external)
Former Celtic recruitment chief Mark Lawwell has returned to frontline football as Chelsea's senior scout working within their first-team scouting and recruitment department. (Scottish Sun, external)
- Saturday's English & European transfer rumours 
  - Published11 hours ago
- Friday's English & European transfer rumours 
  - Published1 day ago
Former Aberdeen manager Jimmy Thelin is among the leading candidates for the vacant Sheffield Wednesday after the League One club sacked Henrik Peterson earlier this month. (Daily Record, external)
Former Rangers manager Michael Beale has been handed a vote of confidence by his club in Belgium after four defeats in a row with Zulte Waregem. (Scottish Sun, external)
Dundee technical director Gordon Strachan has recalled being exiled by the club aged just 15 after scrapping with twins in a reserve team derby against Dundee United. (Open Goal, external)
Former Celtic striker Pierre van Hooijdonk has been cleared of misconduct allegations over allegations of a conflict of interest over son Sydney's switch from Breda to Estrela da Amadora on a free transfer. (The Herald, external)
The Scottish Football Association has issued a 'not so fast' warning to the Scottish Professional Football League following reports the league governing body has opened the way for broadcasters to bid to televise games at 3pm on Saturdays. (The Scotsman, external)
Scottish League Two club Stirling Albion are the subject of a £1m takeover bid by a consortium led by Canadian investor Eric Perez. (The National, external)

חלוץ סקוטלנד רוס סטיוארט נותר במצב לא ברור בסוונסי סיטי לאחר שהמנהל ויטור מטוס לא היה מודע לכללי ההתאחדות לכדורגל באנגליה בנוגע לשחקנים מקומיים, מה שהגביל את הופעותיו של השחקן בן ה-30 בשל אי-הכללת סקוטים בקטגוריה. במקביל, חלוץ סקוטלנד טומי קונוויי נהנה מתפקידו החדש באגף השמאלי תחת מנגר מידלסברו קים הלברג.

בגזרת המועדונים הסקוטיים, ריינג'רס מתכננת לצרף את לייל קמרון לסגלו של דרק מקינס לאחר סיום תקופת ההשאלה שלו בדאנדי יונייטד. מנגד, קשר בלגיה ניקולא רסקין לא צפוי לדחוף לעזיבת ריינג'רס בחלון ינואר הקרוב למרות התעניינות מצד קבוצות באירופה. בנוסף, בלם אברדין מאטס קנואסטר ייעדר לתקופה של ארבעה עד שישה שבועות בשל פציעה בירך.
